attrs.Notes: LaserGate v2 2026-09-24 (fun-builds/models/build_LaserGate.py, primlib parts): tall wide slim laser fence, two emitter pylons (PylonL* at x -5.45, PylonR* at x +5.45, inner faces |x| 4.85). Static prop. Beam1..Beam6 (bottom to top) = ONE Neon ff2f2f Cylinder each, d 0.16, x -4.75..4.75 at z 0, y 1.5/3/4.5/6/7.5/9 - the server shimmers them. Nothing solid within |x| <= 4.8, |z| <= 1.3, y 0..10 except the beams (zombies walk through along Z). Glow* = neon parts the DefenceFX client pulses (GlowLens<L|R>1-6 at the beam ends, GlowEdge, GlowBrow, GlowCap, GlowBeacon); Pivot_Spark1..12 = beam ends (odd -X, even +X, beam i -> 2i-1 / 2i).
